decision: Guard-free page-aligned execution closes the dedicated RX 7900 XTX c1 frontier at 129,024 total tokens (126 Ki, 504 pages): one natural request completes exactly at 23.962624 GiB peak with 0.021751 GiB sampled headroom and clean ownership, while the next 256-token page stalls raw startup warmup beyond 600 seconds and 130,048 tokens (127 Ki, 508 pages) returns HIP OOM. On W7900, the same pure-INT8 route passes the model-native 262,144-token c1 limit with 15.543076 GiB headroom. W7900 c2/c4/c8 all pass 8,192 tokens/request but all fail resident_prepare at 8,448 with NotImplementedError; c4 executes as two physical c2 groups and offered c8 as physical c1+c3+c4 groups, so this Qwen3.8 INT8 route is queue coalescing, not retained continuous batching. A matched W7900 BF16-vs-INT8 mixed_v1 gate at 129,024 prompt tokens and 16 teacher-forced decode steps passes with mean/max KL 0.000010379/0.000135450, 100% top-1, finite logits, all 16 full-attention layers INT8, and zero BF16 mirror bytes.

protocol.context_definition: configured total tokens per request; each request uses context-max_tokens-1 rendered prompt tokens, four generated tokens, and one reserved slot
protocol.request_gate: server ready, HTTP 200, exact rendered prompt count, authoritative generated token IDs/count and generation shape, /ready after the burst, zero final owners, and clean teardown
protocol.quality_gate: BF16 reference and INT8 candidate use identical prompt positions and BF16 teacher tokens for 16 decode steps; all logits must be finite; mean KL <=0.05 and top-1 agreement >=90%
protocol.headroom_interpretation: measured data only; no arbitrary reserve reclassifies a completed request

limitations: The XTX 129,024-token row is one natural request with only 0.021751 GiB sampled headroom; it is a measured physical ceiling, not a margin or reliability recommendation.
The 129,280- and 129,536-token startup failures are bounded 600-second warmup stalls, not returned OOMs. The 130,048-token row is the first returned HIP OOM in the narrowed bracket.
The 129,024/16 quality row is the explicit mixed_v1 bounded control. Complete category coverage remains at 512 and 4K; do not call the 129K row a complete long-context suite.
W7900 c2/c4/c8 8K rows retain BF16 mirrors and therefore do not demonstrate compact-INT8 memory savings.
The measured Qwen3.8 INT8 server route reports continuous_decode=false and variable static queue groups; it is not vLLM/SGLang-style continuous batching.
No throughput or latency claim is made from these capacity and correctness rows.
next: Implement and qualify direct no-mirror c>N INT8 attention under the resident model-owning loop, with stable slots, request-sized paged allocation, live admission/reclaim, chunked prefill/decode scheduling, and truthful physical-width telemetry before claiming production continuous batching for Qwen3.8 INT8.
